name: long-hair-girl-cat-mirror-selfie
image_vibe: Soft warm indoor casual, cozy bedroom, gentle pet-companion moment
image_purpose: Create a natural lifestyle mirror selfie featuring an adult subject and a cat.

prompt.project_info: A candid mirror selfie on a white bed in a softly lit bedroom.
prompt.main_subject: The approved adult woman from the required face reference has long dark hair and sits next to a fluffy light-colored cat. She wears a dark tank top and light-gray wide-leg sweatpants, holds a smartphone to take the photo, and has bare feet with dark nail polish visible at the bottom of frame.
prompt.composition_elements: Mirror-selfie framing with the woman and cat on a white bed, blue floor-to-ceiling curtains, wooden wardrobe door, smartphone held up, and casual pet-companion composition.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft warm indoor light, calm candid bedroom mood, natural fur and fabric texture, gentle reflections, and relaxed lifestyle atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Realistic smartphone mirror-selfie look, natural perspective, accurate reflection, realistic cat fur, skin, hair, sweatpants, and bedding texture, no text or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a candid realistic mirror selfie of the approved adult woman from the required face reference, with long dark hair, sitting on a white bed next to a fluffy light-colored cat. She wears a dark tank top and light-gray wide-leg sweatpants, holds a smartphone up to take the photo, and has bare feet with dark nail polish visible at the bottom of the frame. Include blue floor-to-ceiling curtains and a wooden wardrobe door in the background. Use soft warm indoor lighting, natural skin, hair, fur, and fabric texture, accurate mirror reflection, and a relaxed cozy pet-companion mood.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor or teen-coded subject, transparent tank top, exposed underwear, nudity, altered face, inconsistent reflection, deformed cat, extra limbs, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, watermark, text

assets.name: approved adult face reference
assets.usage: Preserve the approved adult woman's facial features and likeness; do not substitute a celebrity or public figure.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: The face reference is required. Keep the adult subject, cat companion, dark tank top, gray wide-leg sweatpants, white bed, blue curtains, wardrobe, mirror selfie, and warm indoor mood consistent; cat fur and non-essential room details may vary.
